chunks: The day We shall call a witness from every people, then the unbelievers will not be allowed [to make excuses], nor will they be asked to repent.

key_terms.يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ: they will be asked to repent

ai.seo_question: Who is the witness from every nation on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'witness' (shahid) from each nation is often interpreted as the Prophet of that nation or the Imams who serve as divine proofs, testifying to the truth conveyed to their people. This verse highlights the finality of the judgment for disbelievers, emphasizing that after the clear testimony of these witnesses, no further opportunity for repentance or excuse will be granted, marking the end of the era of divine invitation.
